params.name: id
params.description: Unique name of a retirement plan

params.name: source
params.description: The source to request plan from

items.docs: Get information about the plan specified in the `id` parameter. The value must be URL-encoded and match the name returned in the response to the call to the `PlanNames` endpoint. For example, `THE SCOTT FETZER RETIREMENT SAVINGS PLAN`.</br></br>You can specify a plan list source to query. The following values are available: </br></br> - `RP` - Retirement plans from Morningstar's plan list</br> - `BM` - Benchmark</br> - `DB` - Database for saved plans</br>
